risk_note: RV2 ledger (settlement-plan B2-04w; BR-FUND-18, 20; S3, S15; decisions D10-188, D10-191, D10-197). Asset day snapshot: at the nominal D+1 time it writes day D with balances summed from entries with accounting_date <= D and UNION_RECEIVABLE per platform in asset_snapshot_receivables; waiting / estimated come through the PendingEarningsSource port declared here (implemented by settlement, B2-04x). The balance, receivable and estimate reads share one REPEATABLE READ snapshot; one snapshot per (app_id, D) through the PG unique key. Fail-safe deadline (D10-191): the write transaction stores waiting_comparable=false, and a separate confirm transaction reads the Clock and flips it to true only before D+1 00:30; any failure, disconnect or exit leaves it not comparable. Alerts go through an optional AssetSnapshotAlertQueue in the same transaction with an (app_id, day, type) key; making that queue durable and required is B2-04wa (D10-188). Exports the snapshot complete / timed-out read port. Not wired into scheduling (B2-04zb). Only apps/api/src/modules/ledger/** changed.
